metadata.publisher: Gleislicht, derived from SBB and official Zug open data
metadata.dayModel: civil day with preceding service-day spillover
metadata.label: Zug canton — admitted complete stop patterns
metadata.model: scheduled interpolation along inferred official alignments
metadata.note: Admit only complete directed stop patterns on explicitly mapped operator/line geometry. All source calls, branches, call rules and border termini retained. Every pair must pass projection, connectivity and detour checks. Historic official corridor inference, not certified street directions, current diversions or observed movement. Three individually pinned sub-metre topology connectors are inferred and reported per pair and trip; no other gap filling.
metadata.scope: Every annual GTFS trip with at least one source stop inside the complete official Zug polygon, across every agency and mode. Fixture trips retain every source call, including cross-canton termini. No straight-line crossing test for nonstopping through traffic.
exclusions: Annual membership is complete for the pinned national timetable and official canton polygon, not proof of unrepresented real-world services.
Friday/Sunday plus preceding-day carry-in do not establish seasonal, holiday or year-round coverage.
No-stop through traffic is outside this passenger-service inventory.
Geometry admission covers only the mapped official Buslinien source. Rail, mountain, boat and unmatched bus routes remain in the coverage denominator.
The WFS matches the archive within 1 mm but proves no 2026 alignment validity. No realtime.

geometry.license: Free commercial/noncommercial use with mandatory source credit; no CC licence assigned

topologyJoins.method: Three explicitly reviewed sub-metre source endpoint-to-vertex discontinuities on identical line labels. Short straight connectors are inferred geometry, not publisher linework. No automatic proximity joins.

joins.reason: Same-line source endpoint meets an existing vertex of a separate component less than one metre away. Explicit topology normalization; street direction is not certified.
Same-line source endpoint meets an existing vertex of a separate component less than one metre away. Explicit topology normalization; street direction is not certified.
Same-line source endpoint meets an existing vertex of a separate component less than one metre away. Explicit topology normalization; street direction is not certified.

wfsComparison.comparison: Every t_id, exact comma-separated line label, ordered vertex count and each LV95 ordinate, with 1 mm tolerance for export precision. WFS feature IDs differ from GeoPackage IDs.
wfsComparison.vintageConclusion: Current WFS repeats the archive geometry within export precision. Neither a 2026 alignment date nor current diversions are established.

geometry.direction: Undirected source segments filtered by exact line membership. Ordered GTFS calls determine orientation; no one-way street certification.

frequency.model: Source-interval-anchored representative grid when exact_times=0; not scheduled departures.
